metadata.description: Claude skills for Hebrew-language civil litigation work in Israel

plugins.name: takanot-2018
plugins.description: The practical rules of Israel's Civil Procedure Regulations, 2018 (in Hebrew): document structure and page limits, deadlines, counting of days and court recesses, and sanctions. Includes the full text, a deadlines table, per-document checklists and open interpretation questions.

plugins.name: human-hebrew-writing
plugins.description: Rules for Hebrew writing that does not read as AI-generated: words and structures that give a model away, punctuation and formatting rules, and a pre-delivery check.
